title: Requirements Guidance and Mobile Device Use
summary: This small topic combines one positive comment about staff adapting to customer requirements with undetermined mentions of charging requirements and mobile device usage guidance.

positive.summary: The positive review praises staff for adapting well to customer requirements.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined reviews mention explanations about hybrid charging requirements and use with mobile devices without a clear evaluative opinion.

limitations: The topic is based on very few examples, so the content is limited.
